title: Final Formula
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the mass formula M = a + bT_z + cT_z^2.

title: Isospin Requirement
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify that T must be at least 1 to test the formula experimentally.

title: Derivation Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student should outline key steps in deriving the mass formula from the properties of isobars and isospin.

title: Constants Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the significance of the constants a, b, and c in the context of the mass formula.

title: Coulomb Energy Role
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss how Coulomb energy contributes to the mass differences in isobars.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign errors when relating mass differences to neutron-proton mass differences.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all terms in the mass formula are consistent in units.
